description.purpose: The catalogue of one knowledge space: one row per source with its path, kind, format, summary line, tags and top-level names, kept current from the space's announcements, so that `find` answers from one store and wakes no file. THE HIVE IS THE ADDRESS -- everything from outside is sent to the hive path and the hive hands it on.
description.use_when: One per knowledge space whose sources (a file space) announce their head moves on `source_changed`, describe them on `source_described` and answer `info`, `outline` and `list`, beside the graph space of the same space.
description.not_in_scope: No model, no embedding request, no network; no content of a source beyond its summary line; no write tool; no delete (a removal leaves a grave, `tomb` '1').
description.contract_in: Lanes on `hop.route`: source_changed (a node source announced a version, or its removal with `tomb`), source_described (the summary line and tags of an announced version), in_pulled (an answer to one of this hive's own `pull` requests, `op_id` `lib:f:i:<part>:<source>:<version>`, `lib:f:t:<token>` or `lib:g:<token>`), in_lib (a question, hop `op`, `op_id`, `caller?`), in_tool (one tool call of a model), in_schemas (a menu question).
description.contract_out: Routes on `hop.route`, leaving through the hive path: pull (a read request to the file space, `op_id` `lib:f:...`, or a question to the graph space, `op_id` `lib:g:...`, no `caller`), answer (exactly one per `in_lib` question), tool_result (exactly one per tool call), tool_schemas (the menu).

accepts.because: a node source moved a head: body `{source, version, path, fmt, parser, mark, nodes, links, tomb}` (`source` `fh-<12 hex>` or `ob-<12 hex>`, `nodes` the count of its items). Answered by nothing; the hive writes path and format at once and pulls `info` (the kind) and `outline` (the top-level names) of that version, or, with `tomb` (`{source, path, tomb: true}`, no version), turns the row into a grave

a node source wrote the summary of a head: body `{source, version, path, oneline, tags}`, once per head, after `source_changed`. Answered by nothing; summary line and tags are written only while `version` is the announced one -- the description of an older version changes nothing. The path is not taken (it comes from `source_changed`)

the answer to one of this hive's `pull` requests, the answering space's own `answer` restamped: hop `op_id` mirrored -- `lib:f:i:<part>:<source>:<version>` (an `info` or `outline` for the catalogue, written only while that version is still the announced one), `lib:f:t:<token>` (a `list` for `tree`) or `lib:g:<token>` (a graph answer for `symbol` or `related`); the token carries the question. Never answered itself

a question: body `{op, args}`, hop `op`, `op_id`, `caller?`. Ops `find {q, kind?, fmt?, under?}`, `symbol {name}`, `related {addr, how: callers | dependents | deps | similar, depth? <= 3}`, `tree {under?, depth? <= 3}`; every list takes `limit` (<= 20) and `cursor`. Answered by exactly one `answer`; `find` asks no other hive

one tool call of a model: hop `tool_name` (`lib_*`), `tool_call_id`, the arguments as JSON text in the one turn of the body. Translated by `./tools` into an `in_lib` question under `caller` 'tools' and answered by exactly one `tool_result`
a menu question: body `tools`, the names an asking collector declares (`*` = all four). Answered by `./schemas` with exactly one `tool_schemas`

emits.because: a request this hive needs answered, no `caller`: to the file space `info` and `outline` of an announced version (hop `op_id` `lib:f:i:<part>:<source>:<version>`, body `{op, file: '<source>@<version>', source, version, args}`) and `list` for `tree` (`lib:f:t:<token>`, body `{op: 'list', args: {prefix, depth}}`); to the graph space `resolve`, `callers`, `dependents`, `deps` or `similar` (`lib:g:<token>`, body `{op, args}`). Two per announcement, one per graph or tree question

exactly one per `in_lib` question, hop `op`, `op_id` and `caller` unchanged: `{ok: true, op, op_id, items, next, ...}` or `{ok: false, op, op_id, error: {code, message}}`; codes `invalid_input`, `unknown_op`, `store_error`, or the graph or file space's own error handed on

exactly one per tool call, hop `tool_call_id` (and `error_code` when the answer is `ok: false`): one turn `{origin: 'tool', type: 'tool_result', id, text}`, the answer as JSON without `op_id` and `caller`; refused without asking: `tool_unknown`, `bad_request`
the menu: `{schemas, unknown, sidecar: []}`, one declaration per asked `lib_*` name this hive serves (`tools_missing` when the request carried no list)
